criteria.name: Normalized Performance
criteria.description: Your score relative to the best Miner in your specific Intent
criteria.source_quote: 75 points — Normalized Performance (your score relative to the best Miner in your specific Intent)

levels.0: No working Miner integration or mocked data
levels.25: Working integration — Miner runs and returns results, but not competitive
levels.50: Top 10 in Intent — solid performance, above median
levels.75: Top 3 in Intent — competitive with best, consistent high scores
levels.100: Best Miner in your Intent — top of leaderboard, highest canonical score

criteria.what_we_need: Build a Miner that ranks highest in our chosen Intent. Focus on accuracy and consistency of responses.

criteria.name: X Engagement
criteria.description: Quality, consistency, reach, and meaningful engagement of updates posted on X

levels.75: 3-4 posts/week, good reach, shows real progress
levels.100: Daily updates, technical depth, high engagement, community discussion sparked

criteria.what_we_need: Post daily progress on X tagged @Telegraphprotoc. Show technical depth, not just 'working on it'. Share learnings.

tasks.title: Deep-read official rules and scoring formula
tasks.description: Read every word of hackathon.telegraphprotocol.com/rules. Extract exact scoring formula, submission requirements, disqualified behaviors, and any gotchas. Update this active JSON with findings.

output.findings: 75% normalized perf + 25% X engagement. Must use real Miners.

tasks.title: Document Telegraph Miner API + integration patterns
tasks.description: Find the Miner SDK/docs. Document: how to run a Miner, what 'normalized performance' means technically, what intents exist, how to maximize score. Check Discord for hints.

tasks.title: Join Discord and extract community intel
tasks.description: Join the Telegraph Hackathon Discord. Find: what intents are popular, what other teams are building, any tips from organizers, submission tips. Log findings.

tasks.title: Set up local Miner environment
tasks.description: Install Telegraph Miner SDK, get it running locally, connect to testnet if available. Verify we can produce normalized performance scores.

tasks.description: Implement the application that uses real Telegraph Miners. Must demonstrate normalized performance. Our angle: AI detection / WASM scorers.

tasks.title: Post X progress updates

tasks.title: Final submission
